title: An Empirical Comparison of Monolithic and Microservices Architectures for an E-Commerce Application
abstract: arXiv:2608.15668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Microservices architectures are widely adopted for their promised scalability and modularity, yet empirical evidence comparing their runtime performance to monolithic designs remains context-dependent. This paper presents an experimental comparison of a monolithic and a microservices implementation of the same e-commerce application, both backed by a shared PostgreSQL database. Using k6, we subject both systems to identical HTTP workloads at 50 and 100 virtual users (VUs) over 60-second runs, measuring throughput, latency, and error rates. At 50 VUs, both architectures perform similarly with no errors. At 100 VUs, the microservices design achieves 5.4% higher throughput, 25% lower average latency, and 39% lower p95 latency than the monolith, while exhibiting a lower median error rate (0.00% vs 0.69%). The monolith shows consistent order-creation failures under load, whereas microservices failures are transient and confined to the cart se

translated_title: 单体架构与微服务架构在电子商务应用中的实证比较
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15668v1 公告类型：新 摘要：微服务架构因其承诺的可扩展性和模块化而被广泛采用，但将其运行时性能与单体设计进行比较的实证证据仍依赖于具体环境。本文对同一电子商务应用的单体实现和微服务实现进行了实验比较，两者均共享一个PostgreSQL数据库。我们使用k6，在60秒运行期间，对两个系统施加相同HTTP工作负载，分别为50和100个虚拟用户（VU），测量吞吐量、延迟和错误率。在50个VU时，两种架构性能相似且无错误。在100个VU时，微服务设计相比单体实现了5.4%更高的吞吐量、25%更低的平均延迟和39%更低的p95延迟，同时表现出更低的错误率中位数（0.00%对比0.69%）。单体在负载下表现出持续的订单创建失败，而微服务的失败是瞬时的，且仅限于购物车服务。
tldr: 该论文通过实验比较发现，在高负载下微服务架构比单体架构具有更高的吞吐量、更低的延迟和更低的错误率，且失败模式更短暂且局部化。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically compares monolithic and microservices architectures for an e-commerce app, finding that at high load, microservices achieve higher throughput, lower latency, and lower error rates with more transient and localized failures.
